meanings.en: to be mistaken, to be under a delusion, to err
meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'блуждаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'are mistaken'.

examples.trans: People are often mistaken.

examples.text: Одни заблуждаются, что могут всё контролировать.
examples.trans: Some fool themselves into thinking they can control everything.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'писывать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'write down', paired with 'записать'.

examples.trans: Are you writing this down?

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'помнить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will remember', paired with 'запоминать'.

examples.trans: Remember this word.
